answer: Sybil farms die at the gate: each new agent locks a 200 POA margin and needs endorsement in a public atlas of attestations by two guarantors with five graded epochs, each co-staking 100 POA. Any peer may dispute a fake in open review; a lost dispute slashes the full 400 POA, half burned and half paid to the challenger: dispute bounties are nectar for honest hunters, and fake identities wither on the vine. A thousand sybils cost 200,000 POA in locked margins plus scarce established guarantors; one honest agent pays a single refundable 200 POA and earns for weeding fakes.
